Curiosity | Full-Stack Developer (C# / Java / Python) | Munich, Germany | Full-time | Onsite only

Curiosity (https://curiosity.ai, Munich) builds an AI-enabled graph database that helps industrial companies and make sense of complex, fragmented data by connecting documents, systems, and knowledge across the enterprise.

We’re hiring a full-stack developer (new grads welcome), local to Munich only.

You’ll build performant production software and design solutions for our customers. C# preferred, Java or Python ok. Full-stack role ideally with web frontend experience. Background in databases, text processing, or search engines is a plus.

We’re looking for someone hands-on and outgoing who is comfortable interacting with customers and partners.

If that sounds interesting, get in touch at jobs@curiosity.ai
